items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days and does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline, not certification: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Risk severity is high for public launch and medium for bounded changes adding no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: retain private launch gates and block security-sensitive releases; allow only bounded reversible growth and existing read-only evidence work.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Security evidence is incomplete; continue only existing readiness packets with an explicit security evidence boundary, owner, rollback point, and launch blocker. Do not build, publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, add dependencies, or create duplicate queue work.

Do not admit new security-sensitive or production work while delivery is saturated and operational security evidence is unavailable. Continue existing measurement and repair-or-close work only; preserve unknowns and do not requeue unchanged work.

For SearchWoot, retain the private, preview-only gate. Public exposure, alert expansion, deployment, configuration or credential changes, dependency additions, and external outreach remain blocked until access-boundary, secret-handling, isolation, release, TLS, dependency, monitoring, incident, and disclosure evidence is complete alongside the separate rights, privacy, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates.
